Definition: properly, a burden (as causing to faint), i.e. a tax in the form of forced lab or
BiblicalUsage: The word names forced labour, a tax paid in work, and it is the word of Solomon's building and Pharaoh's bondage alike. Pharaoh set taskmasters over Israel to afflict them with their burdens, and Solomon raised a levy of forced labour out of all Israel to build the house of the LORD. Joshua put the Canaanites to tribute and made them serve, and the proverb says the hand of the diligent shall bear rule, but the slothful shall be under tribute.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe forced labour is the mark of a kingdom built on backs instead of blessing, whether the king is Pharaoh or Solomon. I hold that God hears the cry of those under tribute, and the diligent hand He blesses is not the hand that drives others, but the hand that works.
